notes.title: Jul 22, 2015 Update.
notes.notes:
Hi!  We have prepared this update based on your feedback. The update is available for several days now.
[img]https://pbs.twimg.com/media/CH99hwmWUAAfSEz.png[/img]
- Includes improved game balance. Battles are much more challenging now.
- Updates several levels.
- Adds lasers
- Removes end level splash screens
- Removes input handling when the game window is not in focus
- Reduces tutorialization
- Changes sound/music balance
- Includes a lot of other fixes and improvements

Thank you!
Alex and Pavel
